"Would?" is a song by the American rock band Alice in Chains from the Singles: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (1992) and their second studio album, Dirt (1992).
Columbia Records serviced the song to US radio on June 8, 1992.
It was written by guitarist and vocalist Jerry Cantrell as a tribute to his friend Andrew Wood, lead vocalist of Mother Love Bone, who died in 1990.
